title: Checkout Fees and Membership Fee Benefits — Cartwise Grocery Orders Tariff Note
content:
## Tariff note — fees fixed at checkout

This tariff note sets out which fees a Cartwise Grocery Orders order is billed and how Cartwise+ Membership benefits act on them. The fee figures themselves are those of the order's service level.

### Fees billed

1. Fees are fixed at checkout from the order's service level and are billed once per fee type.
2. A delivery order is billed the service level's delivery fee; a pickup order is billed the service level's pickup fee.
3. Priority Delivery adds the service level's priority fee, and Express 30 Delivery adds the service level's express fee, each on top of the delivery fee.
4. A small-basket fee of the service level's small-basket fee amount applies when the service level's small-basket threshold is above zero and the order's item subtotal is below that threshold.
5. A heavy fee of the service level's heavy-order fee applies when the service level's heavy-item threshold is above zero and the order's heavy units exceed that threshold.
6. A busy fee is billed only as the amount the customer accepted at checkout, and never above the service level's busy-pricing maximum.
7. The busy fee is never waived for members, because the busy-pricing member exemption is off for every service level.

The **item subtotal** is the total of the charges on the order's billed item lines. The **heavy units** are the total billed quantity on the order's item lines whose item class is heavy.

### Membership benefits at checkout

8. Membership benefits are applied at checkout from the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order, under that membership's order-benefit rules:
   - the delivery fee is waived (member free delivery) on a service level that is among that plan's free-delivery services, when the item subtotal is at least the plan's free-delivery order minimum;
   - one priority upgrade, when available, replaces the priority fee (member priority upgrade);
   - the express fee is reduced by the plan's express-fee discount percentage (member express discount);
   - the small-basket fee is waived where the plan waives it (member small-basket waiver).
9. Each waived or reduced amount is recorded on the order as a fee-waiver entry, and only the remainder is billed.
10. Benefits never waive the pickup, heavy, busy, cancellation or alcohol return fees.

### Placing the order

11. An order is placed only when its item subtotal is at least the service level's order minimum and its units do not exceed the service level's maximum item count. The order's service level on the order record, together with what the customer puts in the cart, decides this.

### Boundaries shown

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Small-basket threshold above zero, item subtotal exactly at the threshold | No small-basket fee (the subtotal is not below it) |
| Small-basket threshold above zero, item subtotal one cent below it | Small-basket fee applies |
| Small-basket threshold of zero | No small-basket fee at any subtotal |
| Heavy-item threshold above zero, heavy units equal to the threshold | No heavy fee (the units do not exceed it) |
| Heavy-item threshold above zero, heavy units one above it | Heavy fee applies |
| Item subtotal exactly at the order minimum, units within the maximum | The order can be placed |

### Fee-benefit matrix

| Fee | Can a Cartwise+ benefit waive or reduce it? |
|---|---|
| Delivery fee | Yes — waived under member free delivery, when its conditions hold |
| Priority fee | Yes — replaced by one priority upgrade, when available |
| Express fee | Yes — reduced by the plan's express-fee discount percentage |
| Small-basket fee | Yes — waived where the plan waives it |
| Pickup, heavy, busy, cancellation and alcohol return fees | Never |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A Cartwise Grocery Orders delivery order is placed on a service level whose delivery fee is, for this illustration, 4.00, by a member whose plan lists that service level among its free-delivery services and whose free-delivery order minimum is met. At checkout the whole 4.00 is recorded as a fee-waiver entry and nothing is billed for delivery. Had the customer also accepted a busy fee at checkout, that busy fee would be billed in full, since no benefit waives it.
